description: Status of every Hath0r judge at every complexity level from the latest many-facet Rasch calibration (Study B). ATC only observes: the numbers come from the HATH0R-CLI judge-calibration-bot (hath0r evals judges) and are read through HATH0R-MCP evals_judge_calibration_report.

status_levels.amber: not_certified: not enough information (SE above 0.10, too few parts, extreme cell, or no anchor)
status_levels.red: removed_bias or removed_noise: do not use this judge at this level

related.msa: hath0r evals msa report / MCP evals_msa_report (Study A, level-stratified Gage R&R)
related.spc: hath0r spc chart -m judge_severity@<judge>:<level> / MCP quality_spc_status
